description: Google USB Driver: the WinUSB driver for adb and fastboot on Windows (Android ADB and Bootloader Interfaces).
notes: Adds Google's WinUSB driver package to the Windows driver store with pnputil and installs it on the
connected devices that its INF lists, mostly Google phones. Install and uninstall from an elevated shell.
Windows asks once whether to trust the publisher, Google LLC: the package is signed by Google, not by Microsoft.
Most other phones are not in that list, e.g. Xiaomi on MediaTek in fastboot mode (USB\VID_0E8D&PID_201C).
Bind such a device by hand once: Device Manager > the 'Android' device > Update driver > Browse my computer
> Let me pick > Show All Devices > Next > Google, Inc. > Android Bootloader Interface (Android ADB Interface
for adb), and confirm the warning.
'scoop uninstall' removes only the driver packages this install added, also from the devices that use them.
pre_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app installs a driver: run this from an elevated shell."; break }

script: # Windows keeps a published copy of each third-party INF as %windir%\INF\oem<N>.inf; this package's is found by its catalog name.

$findInf = { Get-ChildItem "$env:windir\INF\oem*.inf" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { Select-String -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Pattern '^\s*CatalogFile\.NTamd64\s*=\s*androidwinusba64\.cat' -Quiet } | ForEach-Object Name }
# The catalog is Authenticode-signed by Google LLC, not WHQL, so Windows asks whether to trust the publisher.
# 3010: a reboot is needed; 259: added, but no connected device matched it.
if ($rc -notin 0, 259, 3010) { error "pnputil failed with exit code $rc, the driver was not added."; break }
if ($rc -eq 3010) { warn 'Reboot to finish installing the driver.' }
# Remember only the packages this install added, so that uninstall never removes a copy that was there before.
if (!$added -and $foreign) { info "The driver was already in the driver store ($($foreign -join ', ')); 'scoop uninstall' will not remove it." }
if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app removes a driver: run this from an elevated shell."; break }
# On update the new version adds its own package; only a real uninstall removes drivers.
if (!(Test-Path $list)) { info 'Scoop added no driver package, so there is nothing to remove.'; return }
# oem<N>.inf names are reused after a delete: remove the file only if it is still this package.
if ($LASTEXITCODE -notin 0, 3010) { warn "pnputil could not remove $inf (exit code $LASTEXITCODE); remove it with DriverStore-Explorer." }
